privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft. The final text will be published after legal review.
privacy.collectText: Your Telegram ID, the nickname you choose, your language and your activity in the app (points, completed tasks).
privacy.notCollectText: We don't ask for your real name, phone number, address or photos. Your Telegram name and photo are not stored.
privacy.whyText: To count your points, show the rating and, if you allow it, send reminders.
privacy.whoText: Only your nickname is shown in the rating. Your data is not used for advertising and is never sold.
privacy.deleteText: You can ask us to delete your data at any time. For now, message the bot to do this.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions, message the Ekoustoz bot.
